unikraft.description: Unikraft core. Kraftfiles reference this via the @@UNIKRAFT_LOCAL@@ placeholder resolved by mk/llama.mk. Patches in patches/unikraft/ are re-applied after every checkout/refresh (see scripts/deps.py). Patches 0003-0005 add multi-vCPU SMP support: AP bring-up + SMP-safe allocator (0003), per-LCPU cooperative scheduler with round-robin placement (0004), per-thread CPU affinity state + worker migration fixes + sched_{get,set}affinity syscalls (0005). Together they enable ggml workers to run one-per-vCPU, achieving 3.83x pp512 speedup at SMP=4.
